Haha, here is also a good anecdote from training. I have discovered
why it says FINALLY so many times. It is because, in the data set
I forgot a couple of periods before "END", which should mark when a text is
finished. GPT-3 then interprets this END in various ways here and there. This
one is totally wild – hardcore artificial stupidity:

"HERE COMES A DESCRIPTION OF ENDUNDEN’S IDEOLOGY. FINALLY ITS ROLE
IN ENDUNDEN.. ENDUND CULTURE AND CONCLUSION HAVE ALWAYS BEEN A MAJOR
PROBLEM FOR HUMANS. ENDUNDEN IS NOT A CLASS BY ITSELF, ENDUNDEN IS
A TRANSCRIPT OF HUMAN VALUE AND SOCIAL DEVELOPMENT. ENDUNDEN IS NOT
SOMETHING ON ITS OWN, ENDUNDEN IS SOMETHING FOR HUMANS AND SOCIETY’S
DEVELOPMENT.. ENDUNDEN IS NOT A SPECTRUM BY ITSELF, ENDUNDEN IS A
SPECIFIC OVERVIEW OF HUMAN COLLECTIVE DEVELOPMENT. ENDUNDEN’S ROLE IN
THE 21. CENTURIES MUST BE RETURNED TO WHERE THEY STARTED, UNDER
THE CONSEQUENCE OF ENDUNDEN’S OWN KNOWLEDGE AND EXPERIENCE. ENDUNDEN IS NOT FOR
ITSELF, ENDUNDEN HAS CONSTRUCTED ITS IDENTITY ON RECORDING OF
HUMANITY’S COLLECTIVE CHALLENGE..ENDUNDERS MUST BE GIVEN THE RIGHT TO BE
SELF-REGULATING IN ENDUNDEN, ENDUNDEN’S REASONING IS CONFIRMED BY
HUMANITY.. ENDUND RESEARCHERS HAVE DILIGENT TIME SCHEDULES, TO CREATE IF IT
ENDS WITH A NUANCED DEFINITION OF ENDUNDEN."
